claim_in_v1: its repulsion radius (1.45 m) is larger than the crate-to-goal distance (1.54 m)
why_wrong: 1.54 m is the crate-stack CENTRE-to-goal distance, and 1.45 < 1.54, so the sentence contradicts its own conclusion. gap_rule measures repulsion from the nearest LiDAR return per sector, i.e. from obstacle SURFACES and from the arena walls.
